## Summary

[Partial] Lift, remove bolts and unclip components to position a new aftermarket bumper. [t1047]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Lift the rear of the vehicle to access the bumper area.
2. [Partial] Remove the bolts securing the existing rear bumper cover.
3. [Partial] Unclip and detach any attached tire carrier components if present.
4. [Partial] Position the new aftermarket bumper into place over the frame rails.
5. [Partial] Secure the bumper by reinstalling all mounting hardware in sequence.
6. [Partial] Attach the tire carrier brackets or arms as specified for the model.

_Procedure reported by [t1047]._
